claims.claim: LDR reduces the 256² average position ID-OOD gap from 0.300 to 0.013 in single-task training and from 0.506 to 0.018 in joint five-task training.
claims.what_supported: Within the stated PhyWorld protocol, LDR has substantially smaller gap than DiT-S.
claims.not_supported: Does not establish superiority on natural videos or arbitrary world models.

claims.claim: LDR uses 4.0933M parameters versus DiT-S 106.1114M and is 143.4× faster at 256² in Table 5.
claims.what_supported: The reported implementation and hardware show a large efficiency difference.
claims.not_supported: Not an end-to-end robot latency or cross-hardware guarantee.

claims.claim: Explicit dynamics reasoning is the decisive ablation component.
claims.what_supported: Direct next-latent residual regression is worse, especially under joint training.
claims.not_supported: Because the SL decoder is coupled to structuralization, component effects are not perfectly orthogonal.

claims.claim: LDR generalizes to severe appearance/object shifts.
claims.source: Figure 1 and Figure 5 plus Stress Test text
claims.what_supported: The displayed Pikachu, blue-square/reversed-direction and earth-textured examples are consistent with geometry-conditioned decoding.
claims.not_supported: No broad quantitative distribution over appearances or confidence intervals is reported.

claims.claim: LDR is the first video world model to extrapolate learned dynamics beyond training distribution.
claims.what_supported: This is the authors' stated novelty under their scope.
claims.not_supported: It is qualified by 'to our knowledge' and a footnote restricting validation to simple simulated scenarios.

material_caveats: PDF reports a single seed-42 run and no variance/CI.
Benchmark uses simple objects and white-box simulation; authors explicitly defer richer/real scenes.
Rad metric mostly measures rendering fidelity outside looming.
Several implementation details (CNN/warp architecture, latent dimensionality, sampling distributions) are omitted from the 9-page paper.
